content: Swift Charts auto-builds a baseline accessibility tree (VoiceOver can read data via audio graphs) with zero extra code, but accessibilityChartDescriptor (iOS 17+, conforming to AXChartDescriptorRepresentable with AXNumericDataAxisDescriptor/AXCategoricalDataAxisDescriptor) is the mechanism for richer, custom per-point descriptions and full AudioGraph support -- this is the standard/expected level of accessibility for a native chart, not an extra differentiator.
